risks.mitigation: Trained personnel verify the work area protection per the material and equipment procedures.

risks.affected_roles: Drying operators and personnel around the equipment.
risks.consequence: May cause burns or start a fire.
risks.mitigation: Authorized personnel verify the process equipment and stop and escalate on anomalies.
risks.scenario: Running the dryer when the temperature, time, or combustible material conditions are unverified.
risks.title: Drying heat source.

risks.consequence: May mix up materials or cause coating incompatibility.
risks.mitigation: Check against the work order and original labels, keep misplacement records, and hand them to the responsible person for verification.

risks.consequence: May increase wrist and upper-limb strain.
risks.mitigation: Observe the workstation, rest rotation, and tools, and report ergonomic problems.
risks.scenario: Prolonged fine application without verified workstation rotation arrangements.
risks.title: Repetitive hand motions.
